itemdesc-skateblade-bone: A sharpened bone blade for ice skates.
itemdesc-skateblade-copper: A hammered copper blade. Soft but serviceable.
itemdesc-skateblade-tinbronze: A tin bronze blade. A step up from bone.
itemdesc-skateblade-bismuthbronze: A bismuth bronze blade. Decent alloy work.
itemdesc-skateblade-blackbronze: A black bronze blade. Expensive but durable.
itemdesc-skateblade-iron: A forged iron blade. Good edge retention.
itemdesc-skateblade-blistersteel: A blister steel blade. Nearing the quality of true steel.
itemdesc-skateblade-meteoriciron: A meteoric iron blade. Exceptionally hard.
itemdesc-skateblade-steel: A precision-forged steel blade. The finest edge.
itemdesc-skateblade-silver: A silver blade. Beautiful but far too soft for practical use.
itemdesc-skateblade-gold: A gold blade. Outrageously impractical. Outrageously stylish.
itemdesc-iceskates-bone-rawhide: Crude bone skates lashed with rawhide.
itemdesc-iceskates-bone-leather: Bone skates with proper leather straps.
itemdesc-iceskates-bone-fur: Bone skates with fur straps. Warm and forgiving.
itemdesc-iceskates-copper-rawhide: Copper skates with rawhide. A small upgrade over bone.
itemdesc-iceskates-copper-leather: Copper skates with leather. Comfortable early-game option.
itemdesc-iceskates-copper-fur: Copper skates with fur. Cozy for a beginner's blade.
itemdesc-iceskates-tinbronze-rawhide: Tin bronze skates with rawhide. Decent all-rounder.
itemdesc-iceskates-tinbronze-leather: Tin bronze skates with leather. Solid mid-game choice.
itemdesc-iceskates-tinbronze-fur: Tin bronze skates with fur. Comfortable upgrade.
itemdesc-iceskates-bismuthbronze-rawhide: Bismuth bronze skates with rawhide. Competent blade.
itemdesc-iceskates-bismuthbronze-leather: Bismuth bronze skates with leather. Well-balanced.
itemdesc-iceskates-bismuthbronze-fur: Bismuth bronze skates with fur. Comfortable and capable.
itemdesc-iceskates-blackbronze-rawhide: Black bronze skates with rawhide. Expensive but sharp.
itemdesc-iceskates-blackbronze-leather: Black bronze skates with leather. Premium mid-tier.
itemdesc-iceskates-blackbronze-fur: Black bronze skates with fur. Luxurious for their tier.
itemdesc-iceskates-iron-rawhide: Iron skates with rawhide. Fast but rough.
itemdesc-iceskates-iron-leather: Iron skates with sturdy leather. A solid choice.
itemdesc-iceskates-iron-fur: Iron skates with fur. Swift and comfortable.
itemdesc-iceskates-blistersteel-rawhide: Blister steel skates with rawhide. Approaching greatness.
itemdesc-iceskates-blistersteel-leather: Blister steel skates with leather. Excellent performer.
itemdesc-iceskates-blistersteel-fur: Blister steel skates with fur. Near-endgame quality.
itemdesc-iceskates-meteoriciron-rawhide: Meteoric iron skates bound in rawhide. Otherworldly.
itemdesc-iceskates-meteoriciron-leather: Meteoric iron skates with fine leather. Exceptional.
itemdesc-iceskates-meteoriciron-fur: Meteoric iron skates with fur. Peak performance.
itemdesc-iceskates-steel-rawhide: Steel skates with rawhide. Blazing speed, rough ride.
itemdesc-iceskates-steel-leather: Steel skates with quality leather. Professional-grade.
itemdesc-iceskates-steel-fur: Steel skates with fur. Unmatched speed and comfort.
itemdesc-iceskates-silver-rawhide: Silver skates with rawhide. Pretty, fragile, impractical.
itemdesc-iceskates-silver-leather: Silver skates with leather. All style, little substance.
itemdesc-iceskates-silver-fur: Silver skates with fur. At least your feet are warm.
itemdesc-iceskates-gold-rawhide: Gold skates with rawhide. You absolute show-off.
itemdesc-iceskates-gold-leather: Gold skates with leather. The softest blade money can buy.
itemdesc-iceskates-gold-fur: Gold skates with fur. Functionally terrible. Spiritually magnificent.
itemdesc-icerinkcreator: A magical wand that spawns a 30x15 ice rink with boards. Creative mode only.
blockdesc-sharpenerjig: A wooden cradle with a honing stone for sharpening ice skate blades. Right-click with skates to sharpen.
